unexported.media: the attachments the user sent: the telemetry names an attachment by the file it was read from (`[Image: source: <path>]`), never by its bytes
unexported.tool_calling_round_output: the tool calls of a response that only calls tools, on the call's own span: the Claude Agent SDK's llm_request span records no response content when the model calls tools, and its tool spans and the next request carry them

withheld_reasoning.reason: reasoning the model signed and withheld the text of: the Claude Agent SDK's telemetry exports no reasoning part for it, and no payload holds one
